title: 7 Things It Actually Costs a Godly Man to Work Like Christ Is Watching
caption:
7 things it actually costs a godly man to work like Christ is watching.

The extra twenty minutes nobody clocks. The praise he doesn't correct. The shortcut he doesn't take even though it would save him an hour.

Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord (Colossians 3:23). What he does when no one's grading it is the only grade that's real.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #workethic #discipline
